output_list.reason: The mintToken function is intended to mint new tokens. However, the current implementation is vulnerable to a predictable randomness attack. The function relies on the blockhash of the current block to determine the randomness. If the same block is mined again, the same randomness will be generated. This can be exploited by miners to mint more tokens than intended. The function should use a more secure randomness source.
